english: Small steps can lead to significant changes.
chinese: 小小的行动可以带来显著的变化。
note: lead to 后接名词或动名词，表示“导致”。

english: It takes time to develop a new habit.
chinese: 养成一个新习惯需要时间。
note: It takes time to do sth.：做某事需要时间。

english: Regular practice is more effective than occasional hard work.
chinese: 有规律的练习比偶尔的苦练更有效。
note: 比较级 more effective than；occasional 意为“偶尔的”。

english: The more you review, the better you remember.
chinese: 复习得越多，记得就越牢。
note: the＋比较级，the＋比较级：越……越……。

english: Instead of reading the answer again, try to explain it yourself.
chinese: 不要再读一遍答案，试着自己解释一下。
note: instead of 后接动名词；try to do 表示尝试做。

english: A clear goal makes it easier to decide what to do next.
chinese: 明确的目标使决定下一步做什么变得更容易。
note: make it＋形容词＋to do；it 是形式宾语。

english: Even a short break can help you regain your focus.
chinese: 即使短暂的休息也能帮助你重新集中注意力。
note: help sb. (to) do sth.；regain 表示重新获得。

english: Do not expect every day to be perfect.
chinese: 不要期待每一天都十全十美。
note: expect sb./sth. to do：预期某人或某物做……。

english: What matters most is whether you keep going.
chinese: 最重要的是你是否坚持下去。
note: What 引导主语从句；whether 引导表语从句。

english: You are more likely to continue if the task is small enough.
chinese: 如果任务足够小，你就更有可能坚持。
note: be likely to do：有可能做；形容词＋enough。

english: The library provides students with a quiet place to study.
chinese: 图书馆为学生提供了安静的学习场所。
note: provide sb. with sth.：向某人提供某物。

english: Not all students prefer to study alone.
chinese: 并不是所有学生都更喜欢独自学习。
note: not all 为部分否定，不是“所有人都不”。

english: Students should have access to reliable information.
chinese: 学生应该能够获取可靠的信息。
note: have access to：有机会使用或获取；to 是介词。

english: The course is designed to develop practical skills.
chinese: 这门课程旨在培养实用技能。
note: be designed to do：旨在做；注意被动结构。

english: There is no need to compare your progress with everyone else's.
chinese: 没有必要把自己的进度与其他所有人的进度比较。
note: There is no need to do；else's 表示“其他人的”。

english: Many students find it difficult to balance study and work.
chinese: 许多学生发现很难平衡学习和工作。
note: find it＋形容词＋to do；balance A and B。

english: The project would not have succeeded without teamwork.
chinese: 没有团队合作，这个项目就不会成功。
note: would not have done 表示对过去的虚拟推断。

english: As long as we plan ahead, we can avoid unnecessary stress.
chinese: 只要提前规划，我们就能避免不必要的压力。
note: as long as：只要；avoid 后常接名词或动名词。

english: Some students learn better by discussing ideas with others.
chinese: 一些学生通过与他人讨论想法学得更好。
note: by＋动名词表示方式。

english: It is worth asking questions when something is unclear.
chinese: 遇到不清楚的地方时，提问是值得的。
note: be worth doing：值得做，不能写 worth to do。

english: The author does not reject the idea completely.
chinese: 作者并没有完全否定这个观点。
note: completely 的位置会影响否定范围，留意部分否定。

english: This example is used to support the main argument.
chinese: 这个例子被用来支持主要论点。
note: be used to do：被用于做；不同于 be used to doing。

english: The word refers to a change in people's attitudes.
chinese: 这个词指的是人们态度的变化。
note: refer to：指的是；a change in：在……方面的变化。

english: However, the evidence is not strong enough to support that conclusion.
chinese: 然而，证据还不足以支持那个结论。
note: 形容词＋enough＋to do；evidence 通常不可数。

english: The passage focuses on the benefits of regular exercise.
chinese: 这篇文章主要讨论有规律运动的益处。
note: focus on：重点在于；benefits of：……的益处。

english: The finding suggests that the problem is more complex than expected.
chinese: 这一发现表明，问题比预期更复杂。
note: suggest 在此表示“表明”，不是“建议”。

english: We should consider both the advantages and the disadvantages.
chinese: 我们应该同时考虑优点和缺点。
note: both A and B：A 和 B 两者都。

english: The result depends on how the information is collected.
chinese: 结果取决于信息的收集方式。
note: depend on 后可以接 how 引导的宾语从句。

english: This does not necessarily mean that the method is useless.
chinese: 这并不一定意味着这种方法毫无用处。
note: not necessarily：不一定；阅读中常用于限定结论。

english: Compared with earlier studies, this survey includes more participants.
chinese: 与早期研究相比，这项调查包含更多参与者。
note: Compared with 作比较状语；participants：参与者。

english: The speaker has changed her mind about the trip.
chinese: 说话者改变了对这次旅行的想法。
note: change one's mind：改变主意；留意转折后的新决定。

english: I was going to call you, but my phone ran out of power.
chinese: 我本来打算给你打电话，但手机没电了。
note: was going to：原本打算；run out of：用完。

english: Would you mind turning the music down?
chinese: 你介意把音乐调小声一点吗？
note: Would you mind 后接动名词。

english: The meeting has been put off until next Friday.
chinese: 会议已推迟到下周五。
note: put off：推迟；has been done 是现在完成时被动。

english: You should have told me about the change earlier.
chinese: 你本该早点告诉我这个变化。
note: should have done：过去本该做但未做。

english: I would rather take the bus than drive in heavy traffic.
chinese: 我宁愿坐公交，也不愿在拥堵的车流中开车。
note: would rather do A than do B。

english: The train is due to arrive in ten minutes.
chinese: 火车预计十分钟后到达。
note: be due to do：预计做；in ten minutes 表示十分钟后。

english: There is little chance that we will finish before lunch.
chinese: 我们午饭前完成的可能性很小。
note: little 表示“几乎没有”；chance that 后接同位语从句。

english: I had no idea that the library closed so early.
chinese: 我原先不知道图书馆这么早关门。
note: have no idea that：不知道……；听力中常表达意外。

english: Why don't we ask the teacher for some advice?
chinese: 我们为什么不向老师征求一些建议呢？
note: Why don't we do 用于提建议；advice 不可数。

english: In my view, learning a language requires both practice and patience.
chinese: 在我看来，学习一门语言既需要练习，也需要耐心。
note: In my view 用于表达观点；动名词短语作主语。

english: One possible reason is that students have different learning needs.
chinese: 一个可能的原因是学生的学习需求不同。
note: One possible reason is that... 可用于解释原因。

english: For example, a short daily review can improve long-term memory.
chinese: 例如，每天简短的复习可以改善长期记忆。
note: for example 后接具体例子，避免只重复观点。

english: This approach not only saves time but also reduces waste.
chinese: 这种方法不仅节省时间，还能减少浪费。
note: not only...but also... 连接两个谓语，主语为单数。

english: Although technology offers convenience, it cannot solve every problem.
chinese: 尽管技术带来了便利，但它不能解决所有问题。
note: Although 与 but 不要在同一个主从结构中重复使用。

english: We need to strike a balance between efficiency and quality.
chinese: 我们需要在效率和质量之间取得平衡。
note: strike a balance between A and B：在两者间取得平衡。

english: It is important for students to take responsibility for their own learning.
chinese: 学生对自己的学习负责是重要的。
note: It is＋形容词＋for sb. to do；take responsibility for。

english: Rather than replacing teachers, digital tools can support them.
chinese: 数字工具可以辅助教师，而不是取代教师。
note: Rather than 后的动名词短语表达对照。

english: To address this problem, universities could offer more practical courses.
chinese: 为了解决这个问题，大学可以开设更多实践课程。
note: To do 作目的状语；address 表示“处理、解决”。

english: Therefore, small but consistent changes may be the best starting point.
chinese: 因此，小而持续的改变可能是最好的起点。
note: therefore 表示因果结果；consistent：持续一致的。

english: Public transport plays an important role in city life.
chinese: 公共交通在城市生活中发挥着重要作用。
note: play an important role in：在……中起重要作用。

english: More and more people are becoming aware of environmental protection.
chinese: 越来越多的人开始意识到环境保护的重要性。
note: become aware of：意识到；environmental 为形容词。

english: The city is famous for its long history and traditional culture.
chinese: 这座城市以悠久的历史和传统文化而闻名。
note: be famous for：因……闻名；不同于 be famous as。

english: With the development of technology, people's lives have changed greatly.
chinese: 随着技术的发展，人们的生活发生了很大变化。
note: with＋名词短语作状语；发生至今的变化用现在完成时。

english: The museum attracts visitors from all over the world.
chinese: 这座博物馆吸引着来自世界各地的游客。
note: attract 为及物动词；from all over the world 修饰 visitors。

english: This tradition has been passed down from generation to generation.
chinese: 这一传统代代相传。
note: pass down：传承；has been done 表示被动。

english: Online learning allows students to study at their own pace.
chinese: 在线学习让学生可以按自己的节奏学习。
note: allow sb. to do；at one's own pace：按自己的节奏。

english: The government has taken measures to improve public services.
chinese: 政府已采取措施改善公共服务。
note: take measures to do：采取措施做某事。

english: The festival provides an opportunity for families to get together.
chinese: 这个节日为家人团聚提供了机会。
note: an opportunity for sb. to do：某人做某事的机会。

english: Protecting cultural heritage is a responsibility shared by everyone.
chinese: 保护文化遗产是每个人共同承担的责任。
note: 动名词短语作主语；shared by everyone 是过去分词短语。
